initial_conditions: The revision 3 original patterns use the saved rotated warp direction for Basin.
actions: Observe that File disables both pattern raster commands in an empty studio.
Open the original revision 3 fixture and use Frame all.
In the File JPEG dialog, use the 869 by 723 mm fitted crop, enter 127 PPI and enable Grainline.
Save the native 4345 by 3615 JPEG as fit.jpg.
Open the action from Command search with Command-K, query, Tab and Return.
Set the crop to 2000 by 200 mm with Left U −1000 mm and Bottom V 275 mm. Enter 72.4 PPI and enable Grainline.
Observe 72 PPI recorded density and 5669 by 567 pixels. Check the 5669.3 px width field and switch back to 2000 mm.
Cancel the native chooser and verify the crop and density persist. Save two-metre.jpeg.
Compare native, CLI and MCP JPEG bytes. Read JFIF density and baseline-frame dimensions independently, then decode and check authored marks.
expected_outcomes: The fitted JPEG is 4345 by 3615 at 127 PPI. A 2 m by 200 mm crop requested at 72.4 PPI is 5669 by 567 at a recorded 72 PPI. Native, CLI and MCP JPEGs agree, previous PNG bytes agree, and the project and prior destination retain their bytes on the checked failure paths.
